name: Page Curl
description: A booklet page whose lower corner lifts into a curl when you reach for it, showing its underside and the page beneath; drag it past halfway to turn, or pull the last page back from the left.

props.name: pages
props.description: The pages in order. Each fills a sheet with a 4:5 shape, so give it its own padding.

props.name: index
props.description: The page shown, when you control it. Changing it from outside jumps to that page.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The page shown first when uncontrolled.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called when a page has turned, by drag, click, the buttons or the arrow keys.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the booklet for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which holds the sheet and the page buttons beneath it. Set its width; the sheet keeps a 4:5 shape. Other div props are passed through.
